Comment: ShareKind Cloud Platform - Order Procurement and Fulfillment State Machine (AWS Step Functions)

ValidateOrderInput.Comment: Validates incoming procurement order request against NGO budget and requirements

AuthorizeDonationFunds.Comment: Verifies donor allocation and earmarks simulated funds for procurement

NotifySupplierForAcceptance.Comment: Transmits procurement quote and order specification to supplier fulfillment portal

ProcessDispatchLogistics.Comment: Updates delivery carrier tracking and generates verifiable bill of lading

NotifyBeneficiaryNGO.Comment: Sends real-time notification to NGO director with ETA and verification code

OrderFulfillmentSuccess.Comment: Procurement order successfully validated, funded, dispatched, and confirmed.

SupplierOutOfStock.Cause: Selected supplier does not have sufficient capacity to fulfill requested quantity.

PaymentAuthorizationFailed.Cause: Donation fund earmarking could not be validated.

OrderValidationFailed.Cause: Order failed input schema validation or budget constraints.
